row_exceptions.finance_expenses.legacy_claim_id: Any non-null link is a cutover decision/blocker, not blanket UAT acceptance.

VP-document-assets/master logos/signatures KEEP. Unknown/orphan objects require decision; SQL metadata deletion is not object-storage cleanup.
